description: 一批可开关的原版改动（共 15 条规则）：炼药锅结冰与产物、水桶/水瓶不消耗、村民低价与交易不涨价、铁傀儡不主动攻击玩家、新手村民交易不重置、火药点火、村民与傻子互相转化（转回时重置职业、经验与交易）、二者与僵尸村民治愈的快速转化、图书管理员售卖全部宝藏附魔书等。A Carpet add-on with 15 toggleable vanilla tweaks: cauldron freezing and its product, non-consuming buckets and bottles, villager trade prices and price hikes, passive iron golems, persistent novice trades, ignitable gunpowder, villager/nitwit conversion that resets profession, experience and trades on the way back, instant conversions, and librarian trades for every treasure enchantment book.
